scope_summary: Adds one understated, opt-in line in the homepage 'Build status' section linking to the existing personal field note 'Living Slightly Out of Sync'. Fills the 'who is behind this' trust gap without front-and-center marketing. No new data, claims, scripts, or payments.

legal_and_regulatory.rationale: Internal link to an existing first-party essay published under the owner's chosen public name; introduces no new legal obligation or data collection.
evidence: no forms, scripts, or third-party calls added

privacy_local_first_promise.rationale: Static internal anchor; collects and transmits nothing, adds no tracking.
evidence: plain <a> tag, no JS, no analytics added

medical_scope_and_claims.rationale: Founder-bio line makes no diagnosis or treatment claim; existing page disclaimer remains intact.
evidence: page retains 'Divergify does not diagnose, treat, or replace professional care.'

behavioral_science_alignment.rationale: Opt-in, low-pressure disclosure; reduces trust friction without coercion or dark pattern.
evidence: link is passive and user-initiated, not a modal/interstitial

neurodivergence_research_alignment.rationale: Understated placement honors ND preference for low-stimulus, non-intrusive information that can be sought when capacity allows.
evidence: placed in quiet Build-status section, not the hero; 'if you want the story' framing keeps it optional

user_benefit_and_harm_check.rationale: Adds founder transparency/trust; purely additive link with no foreseeable harm.
evidence: no removal or alteration of existing content/flows

brand_voice_and_claims.rationale: Copy matches existing warm, non-salesy voice and makes no inflated claim.
evidence: 'Built by one neurodivergent brain, for the rest of ours.'

accessibility_and_inclusion.rationale: Keyboard-accessible text link reusing existing .text-muted style; low cognitive load.

security_and_reliability.rationale: Static markup only; no new scripts or network; site continues to build and serve.
evidence: one anchor element added, no runtime changes

monetization_and_dark_pattern_check.rationale: Change introduces no monetization element or purchase pressure.

ship_decision.conditions: All pillars pass or n_a; change is additive, static, and non-data-touching.
